name: Klaus-Dieter Ziegler
bio:
Klaus-Dieter's motorsport journey began not on the track, but in the garage. He spent his youth dismantling and rebuilding engines with his father, a local mechanic. This hands-on experience instilled in him a deep appreciation for the technical intricacies of racing. He transitioned to coordinating test drivers after a short stint as a data analyst for a Formula 3 team. 

Klaus-Dieter is known for his meticulous planning and unrelenting pursuit of optimal performance. He believes that every test session is a chance to uncover hidden potential, and he pushes his drivers to the absolute limit. His demanding nature, while sometimes abrasive, stems from a genuine desire to extract the best possible data and feedback for the team. He is driven to find the smallest advantage, striving for perfection in every aspect of testing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed to the side with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Klaus-Dieter is a man of medium build with a focused gaze that conveys his seriousness.

quirks: Insists on using a specific brand of stopwatch, claiming it's the most accurate.
Always carries a worn copy of a technical manual, frequently referencing it.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically against his clipboard when deep in thought.
